title: Register `docs` pytest marker in pyproject.toml and tests.md
objective: Add a `docs` marker to the pytest configuration and the .claude/rules/tests.md tier registry so doc-tier tests can be selected without falling back to integration.

plan_assets.asset_description: Follow-up item 14: Test-rules docs tier mismatch

scope: Edit .claude/rules/tests.md to register docs alongside slow, gpu, e2e
implementation_steps: Locate current markers section in pyproject.toml
Add docs marker entry with description "documentation-anchor / doc-tier tests"
Update .claude/rules/tests.md tier registry to include docs
Verify uv run pytest --markers lists docs
deliverables: Marker visible via uv run pytest --markers
acceptance_criteria: uv run pytest --markers lists docs alongside slow, gpu, e2e
No PytestUnknownMarkWarning for docs after the marker is used
risks: pyproject.toml edit could break --strict-markers if syntax malformed — mitigation: run `uv run pytest --markers` after edit

commands.command: uv run pytest -m "not slow and not gpu" --tb=line -q

completion_notes: docs marker appended to root pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options].markers and registered in .claude/rules/tests.md ## Markers section.
Gate-C subprocess probe needed -c/--rootdir flags to find project pyproject.toml when running from tmp_path; baked into test_no_unknown_mark_warning_for_docs.
Full fast suite (1765/1765) confirms zero regressions.
